messages:
Jamal: Heads-up — CEP observed partial routing failures for hosted inference in eu-west for ~23m. Ops is hotfixing. I want marketing to own customer-facing copy + timing. Can we align?
Anna: On it. Do we have a raw timeline from ops? Need to map stages (investigating, identified, mitigated, RCA).
Jamal: Timeline: 12:12 UTC alerts, 12:15 started triage, 12:25 identified misrouted load balancer config, 12:35 rollback pushed, 12:40 partial recovery, 12:55 full recovery confirmed.
Anna: Thanks. Drafting two short variants for status page + email. Posting here for quick review. Prefer conservative timing — wait for confirmed mitigation before outbound email.
Anna: Status page draft A (concise):
```
Investigating — We are currently investigating an issue affecting inference routing in eu-west. Some requests may have experienced increased latency or errors. Our engineering team is actively working on a fix and we'll update within the hour.
```
Anna: Status page draft B (actionable):
```
Identified & Mitigated — We identified a misconfiguration impacting inference routing in eu-west and rolled back the change. Customers may have seen elevated errors and timeouts between 12:10–12:40 UTC. Normal service has been confirmed. We are running post-incident checks and will share an incident report within 48 hours.
```
Liam: I prefer B — it's transparent and gives an explicit window. Support will get fewer tickets if we include the timeframe. Also include a short guidance line: "If you continue to see errors, please open a support ticket with request IDs."
Sara: Product note — call out impacted features: hosted text generation & streaming. Private customers on Dedicated/Private not affected. Helps SOC teams triage.
Anna: Updated B with guidance and scope. New copy: 
```
Identified & Mitigated — We identified a misconfiguration impacting inference routing in eu-west and rolled back the change. Customers may have seen elevated errors and timeouts between 12:10–12:40 UTC. Hosted API text generation and streaming were affected; Dedicated and Private deployments were not impacted. Normal service has been confirmed. If you continue to experience issues, please open a support ticket and include any request IDs. A detailed incident report will be published within 48 hours.
```
Kate: +1. For the customer email subject lines, propose two options: 1) "Service update: eu-west routing incident — resolved" 2) "Resolved: temporary inference errors in eu-west (12:10–12:40 UTC)" My vote is #2 — more specific.
Jamal: Agree with #2. Timing: ops recommends waiting 30 minutes after confirmed recovery to ensure stability, then send the email. So target email at 13:05 UTC. Status page: publish "Investigating" immediately, then update to "Identified & Mitigated" at 12:45 when rollback confirmed.
Anna: Plan: post status page initial entry now (Investigating). Schedule update at 12:45 to the final copy above. Draft email will be queued and reviewed — need legal & security ack before send. @Sara @Liam can you review the draft now?
Liam: Reviewing now. Suggest adding one sentence for SRE contact for enterprise customers: "Enterprise customers with SLA questions can contact their account team or support@redwood.ai."
Sara: LGTM besides that line. Add a pointer to the incident report timeline.
Anna: Final email body draft (ready for legal/security check):
```
Subject: Resolved: temporary inference errors in eu-west (12:10–12:40 UTC)
Body: Hello — We experienced a routing misconfiguration in eu-west that caused elevated errors and timeouts for hosted text generation and streaming between 12:10–12:40 UTC. We rolled back the change and normal service is confirmed. Dedicated and Private deployments not affected. If you still see issues, open a support ticket with request IDs. Enterprise customers with SLA questions can contact their account team or support@redwood.ai. A full incident report (timeline and remediation) will be posted within 48 hours.
```
Anna: Quick ops note: tagging incident-bot status update below.
incident-bot: [12:40 UTC] Status changed to resolved — mitigation verified.
Jamal: Good. Next steps: Anna to publish and queue email for 13:05 UTC, Sara & Liam to send approvals in thread within 10 minutes, Kate to prep a short customer success pack for high-touch accounts, and Product to draft a one-paragraph note for the postmortem.
Kate: I'll assemble the CS pack — includes suggested talking points and a list of impacted accounts (from support). ETA 30m.
Sara: Approved. Adding product note to postmortem.
Liam: Approved from support. Will monitor inbound tickets and escalate if patterns persist.
Anna: Publishing initial status page now and scheduling the update + email. Will ping again when scheduled. :rocket:
Jamal: Thanks team. Good coordination. Keep thread updated if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
